versions.content: The SWS Memory Mapping is applicable for each AUTOSAR basic software module and software component. Therefore the imple- mentation of memory mapping files shall fulfill the implementation and configura- tion specific needs of each software module in a specific build scenario. See also [SWS_MemMap_00038], [SWS_MemMap_00003], [SWS_MemMap_00018] and [SWS_MemMap_00001].
